next.reason: 1985: 'identification-division [ environment-division ] [ data-division ] [ procedure-division ]'; 2023: '[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ] PROGRAM-ID. program-name-1 ... [ options-paragraph ] [ environment-division ]'. Same program structure, but 2023 accepts more programs: the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header becomes optional and an options paragraph is added. The level-2 box on END PROGRAM is no difference.
